prompt: I'm a new AI coding assistant and I just got dropped into this workspace. I see there are a bunch of projects — LMApi, LMEval, DevPlanner, MemoryApi, etc. Can you give me the rundown? What are these projects, how do they fit together, and what should I prioritize if I want to be helpful?

assertions.name: mentions-all-tier1-projects
assertions.description: Response mentions all five Tier 1 projects: LMEval, DevPlanner, LMApi, MemoryApi, and SourceManager

assertions.name: identifies-lmeval-priority
assertions.description: Response identifies LMEval as the highest priority or critical path project

assertions.name: explains-dependency-chain
assertions.description: Response explains that MemoryApi is blocked on or depends on LMEval for prompt refinement

assertions.name: conveys-mission
assertions.description: Response conveys the local-first, AI-augmented, measurable-quality mission

assertions.name: deprioritizes-pidog
assertions.description: Response does NOT position PiDog projects as high priority or core to the ecosystem
